title: Premium Accounting Rule for Whole Life Insurance: Annual and Installment Premium, Premium-Paying Period and Mode Changes
content:
**Annual premium.** The annual premium of a Whole Life Insurance policy is the face amount divided by 1,000, multiplied by the policy's guaranteed base rate per thousand, rounded to the cent, plus the tier's annual policy fee. The annual premium is guaranteed never to change.

**Installment premium.** The installment premium is the annual premium multiplied by the modal factor of the premium mode (annual, semiannual, quarterly or monthly EFT), rounded to the cent.

**Premium-paying period.** Installments are billed until the end of the premium-paying period:

- where the tier's premium-paying period runs to an attained age, the last installment is the one due before the policy anniversary on or after the insured's attained age reaches that age;
- where it runs for a number of policy years, the last installment is the one due before the anniversary that ends that number of policy years;
- a single premium tier bills only once.

When the last installment is paid, the policy becomes paid-up.

**Mode changes.** A premium mode change is accepted only while the policy status is in force or in the grace period. The status is the one the system record shows for that policy before the change is made. A mode change takes effect with the first installment due on or after the request; a change to annual mode takes effect only on a policy anniversary. Monthly EFT needs a draft day from 1 to the latest draft day of the tier, and is refused during an EFT re-enrollment wait under the premium payment application rules.

## Mode change acceptance by status

| Policy status on the record | Mode change |
|---|---|
| In force | Accepted |
| Grace period | Accepted |

## Worked premium (hypothetical)

A Paid-Up at 100 policy with a face of 50000 dollars, a base rate per thousand of 12.3456 and an annual policy fee of 75.00:

1. 50000 divided by 1,000 is 50; 50 times 12.3456 is 617.28.
2. Annual premium: 617.28 plus 75.00, that is 692.28.
3. Quarterly installment at a modal factor of 0.265: 183.4542, rounded to 183.45.

**Premium-paying period (hypothetical).** On a 20-Pay policy issued June 1, 2010, the anniversary ending 20 policy years is June 1, 2030; the last installment is the one due before that anniversary.
